relevance_note: A randomized placebo-controlled trial of SGS-742 in patients with succinic semialdehyde dehydrogenase deficiency ('Nineteen subjects were consented and enrolled'), with a per-patient table of clinical findings, MRI and ALDH5A1 variants.
method_note: Read only the paper, the schema and the rules. Table 1 lists 19 patients as rows with a bare-number 'Patient' column, so labels are 'Table 1 #<n>'; the paper uses no per-person label in its text ('one patient', 'two patients'), and no other individual-level person is described. Spans are copied verbatim from the markdown; each table row is one line, so a span from the patient label to the target cell is contiguous. No table contains stacked ' / ' cells. Uncertainties and choices: (1) all 19 enrolled patients are in scope; only 16 have a printed ALDH5A1 variant, and patients Table 1 #10 and #11 (enzymatic quantification) and #12 (elevated urine gamma-hydroxybutyrate) get no variants row because no variant is tied to them; (2) zygosity is 'not reported' for the 13 patients whose cell lists two variants separated by ';', because the paper never states 'compound heterozygous' or heterozygosity, and 'homozygous' only for #5, #8, #16 where the cell says 'homozygous'; (3) variant_type_as_stated is 'not reported' everywhere because the authors state no class for any variant, and pathogenicity is 'not reported' because 'two pathogenic ALDH5A1 gene variants' is an eligibility criterion, not a per-person statement; (4) the transcript 'NM_001080.3' is printed only in the Table 1 column header and is recorded for every variant row from that header; (5) patients #9 and #19 are listed as 'possible seizures' and #15 as '? Movement disorder'; as these are not explicitly reported present or absent, no phenotypic_features row is emitted and the matching checklist items stay 'not reported'; (6) for the two patients with MRI 'normal' (#10, #12) the feature is written as the paper writes it ('normal MRI brain', excluded) and the checklist MRI items are left 'not reported', since a normal investigation as a whole excludes nothing more specific; (7) checklist 'intellectual disability' is 'not reported' for everyone because the paper reports it only as a count ('the majority (13 of 14 participants) of these subjects meet established criteria for Intellectual Disability (DSM-V)') and 'global delay' in Table 1 is not the same wording; (8) 'behavior disorder' (#7, #11, #17) is recorded against the checklist item 'aggression or disruptive behavior' as the closest stated behavior problem; (9) sex, age at onset, age at diagnosis (mean 4.7 +/- 4.6 years, range 0-20 years), ethnicity, consanguinity, vital status and treatment are reported only for the group, so they are 'not reported' per individual; (10) EEG findings, adverse events and laboratory findings are reported by counts without names and are therefore not assigned to anyone; (11) is_proband is false for all 19 because the paper never calls anyone a proband or index case (it is a trial cohort) and none is the single patient of a case report.
